transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, lately I just can't seem to keep my head clear at work. I'm a therapist, and I've been losing track of what my clients are saying right in the middle of a session. I end up rereading the same chart note over and over again because it just doesn't sink in. And then... I don't know, I just freeze up on simple decisions that I used to handle without even thinking about it. It's really starting to affect my job.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?

I'm not really sure. I haven't exactly felt sad, if that's what you mean. I haven't really thought about it as being depressed, to be honest. I mostly just notice how much I'm struggling to focus and get through my day-to-day stuff at work.
Have you noticed any recent medical problems or physical symptoms that started around the same time as your trouble concentrating?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I haven't been sick or had any pain, and physically I feel fine. It's pretty much just the mental fog and not being able to focus that's been the issue.
Have you been feeling unusually worried or anxious lately?

Not really. I mean, I get a little stressed out when I realize I'm falling behind on my chart notes, but... I wouldn't say I feel anxious or worried in general. I don't feel nervous about anything specific. It's really just that my brain feels like it's stalling out.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess I have. Um... my guitar has just been sitting in the corner lately. I keep bailing on my soccer games and my volunteer shifts at the shelter. And even when I try to force myself to do things I usually like, like cooking or going for a hike, it just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it anymore, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or hopeless lately?

No, not really. Um... I don't feel sad, if that's what you mean. I'm not crying or feeling like my life is hopeless or anything like that. It's really just... I just feel kind of blank, like I was saying before with not wanting to do my normal stuff. But I wouldn't say I actually feel down.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Yeah, definitely. I just feel so drained all the time. Even small stuff, like... I don't know, just taking a shower, or driving to the clinic, or trying to finish my paperwork... it all just feels like I'm dragging around a backpack full of bricks. It just takes so much effort to do anything.
Have you been having trouble with sleep lately?

Yeah, I have. It's frustrating because, like I said, I'm so drained. I get home from work just completely tired, but then I get in bed and I just... I lie there for hours. My mind just keeps replaying the day over and over. And then, if I actually do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm even goes off. When I finally get up, it feels like I barely slept at all.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

Yeah, it's definitely changed. Um... most days I just don't feel hungry at all. I usually don't even realize I haven't eaten until someone reminds me to. I've been skipping meals without really meaning to do it, and... well, I've noticed my pants have gotten pretty loose lately because of it.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual lately?
Um, no, not really. I mean, I'm definitely tired, like I said, but I don't think I'm actually moving or talking any slower than normal. At least, no one has pointed anything like that out to me.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Yeah, I have. Um, it happens a lot at work. If I miss just one detail in a note, or forget to return a call right away, I just keep telling myself that I'm useless. I really feel like I'm letting the clients down, and... and everyone else at the clinic, too.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?

Yeah, I have. Um... I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But I just keep having these thoughts that it would be easier if I didn't wake up in the morning. And honestly, it scares me, because I know exactly what those kinds of thoughts can mean.
